name: @enduva/tools
description: Repository audits (TypeScript 7 only, T1), the negative-test runner the interim CLA gate (cla-gate.mjs, run by the `cla` workflow) and the production receipt gate (receipt-gate.mjs, deploy/scripts/db-push.sh). Run them from the root: `pnpm audit:ts`, `pnpm test:negative`.

scripts.test: node audit-lockfile.mjs --self-test && node audit-bundled-typescript.mjs --self-test && node audit-why-typescript.mjs --self-test && node negative-tests.mjs --self-test && node cla-gate.mjs --self-test && node receipt-gate.mjs --self-test && ../deploy/scripts/db-push.test.sh && node supabase-auth-bootstrap.mjs --self-test && node synthetic-accounts.mjs --self-test
